The '''Moon Festival''' was a holiday celebrated on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Omman Minor]]. A [[Fireworks/Legends|firework]] display signalled the start of the Festival, and residents of [[Capital City (Omman)|Capital City]] took to the streets in gaudy costumes to celebrate.<ref name="II">{{JournalCite|12|Idol Intentions}}</ref>
